au-cooling-v1.release_note: NCC 2022 profile records are prepared as cited candidates. They become calculation-eligible only after the source-pack release review marks each record approved and released.
au-cooling-v1.notes: Only legally permitted metadata, citations and approved numerical facts are stored. Proprietary standard text is not copied into the cache.
au-cooling-v1.target_policy_note: released_binding_targets is a policy ceiling, not an approval. A record may supply an automatic default only if it is approved, released by a named reviewer, in-scope, unexpired, and its binding target appears below. blocked_binding_targets can never be defaulted at all.
